description: Create a well-formed git branch named prefix.type.TICKET.short-description, where the prefix is the author's initials or whatever the project documents — for example abc.feat.FSS-373.multi-currency-invoices — dropping the ticket segment when no ticket or issue number exists (abc.fix.null-session-token). Validates the name against git ref rules and Conventional Commits types, branches from an up-to-date base, and protects uncommitted work. Trigger on "create a branch", "new branch for this", "branch off main", "start work on FSS-373", "make me a branch", "cut a branch for this ticket", or when starting work that should not land on the current branch. For deleting or pruning branches use clean-branch; for opening the PR afterwards use create-pr.
